title: Hazrat ki judai me tadapte hai dile zaar ya ahmade muqtaar
body:
Hazrat ki judai me tadapta hai dile zaar, ya Ahmade Muqtar, Ummat pe fida kar diya Shabbir sa dildar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
Baithe na kabhi zere falak chain se dam bhar, aye shaafiye mehshar, Ummat ne diye apko azaar pe azaar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
Dil apka bewajah laeenou ne dukhaya, duniya ne sataya, The ap na doulat ke na duniya ke talabgar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
Zaaher me the sab dost magar dushmane jaa'n the, mardood jaha'n the, Baad aapke kya kya na kiya zulm ka izhaar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Darwaza gira zakhmi hua pehlu e Zehra, aur ek yehi kya, Be deeno ne bekas ko diye sainkdo azaar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
Thi mout Ali ko yuhi Zehra ki judai, phir tegh bhi khayi, Aqir ko sitam sehke uthe Haidere Karrar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
Phir zeher se mara Hasane sabz qaba ko, pabande bala ko, Bekas ke janaze pe huwi teerou ki bochaar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
Shabbir ka marna toh qayamat tha ghazab tha, wa hasrato darda, Woh tashnalabi bewatani aur woh azaar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zakhm itne sahe dil pe yeh Hazrath ka jigar tha, sab peshe nazar tha, Ghar deke huwe baqshish e ummat ke talabgaar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
Hai mout ghulamou ke liye apki rehlat, aye shaafiye ummat, Dil seeno me rote hai har ek chashm hai qoo'n baar, ya Ahmade Muqtar.
